rating.name: The Professional Idiots
rating.observation: RAT public entity workspace displays a static Needs Attention placeholder because public explorer data does not expose per-rating Judge admission. A separate account-specific viewer/queue check is needed to distinguish a Judge API inclusion issue from viewer eligibility or scope. Do not mutate event, state, scheme, or score.

reasons: Safe media uploads accept only avatar and rate_my purposes.
The existing media_assets constraint permits only profile_avatar and rate_my attachments.
MediaVisibility does not provide public Thing-cover attachment access.
The community editing UI records HTTPS image_url as a pending correction, not an uploaded or displayed cover image.
coverImage.required_separate_work: Implement first-class moderated Thing cover/profile attachment using MediaPipeline, safety limits, attachment access, moderation and claimant/community permissions. Do not enable arbitrary URLs or relax safety constraints in PR170.
